lines: 97k stars for one plugin that gives Claude Code a memory.
Normally, a new session starts without anything the last one learned.
claude-mem captures everything your agent does, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context into future sessions.
Five lifecycle hooks follow every session. Each tool call becomes an observation, summarized and stored in SQLite and Chroma.
When Claude needs the past, it searches its memory in three layers.
First, a compact index: 50 to 100 tokens per result. Full details come only for filtered IDs: 500 to 1,000.
Filter first, fetch later: about 10× fewer tokens.
Not just Claude Code: it works with Codex, Gemini, Copilot, OpenCode and more.
Wrap sensitive content in private tags, and it stays out of storage.
One command installs it: npx claude-mem install. Or add it from the plugin marketplace inside Claude Code.
Context that survives every session. Send this to someone who re-explains their project every morning.
claude-mem. Apache 2.0, because agent memory should be easy to embed.
